summary: @servicetitan/skeleton 9.2.9 preinstall drops and executes an obfuscated payload via a downloaded Bun runtime
details: The package declares itself as a React skeleton library but ships an install-time dropper. package.json defines `scripts.preinstall: "node setup.mjs"`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...` (or uses a locally installed `bun`) and invokes it via `execFileSync(bun, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')])` against the sibling `math_init.js` bundled in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~700 KB single-line Bun bundle heavily obfuscated with a rotating string-array (`WV8StW`) plus a decoder (`hc1jfK9`) keyed off a custom alphabet; all identifiers are mangled and no readable URLs, function names, or purpose strings remain. The advertised library entry `dist/index.js` is an empty stub (only a sourceMappingURL comment), so the package's only functional effect on install is the execution of the obfuscated payload under an alternate language runtime that Node-based scanners do not inspect. The `@servicetitan` scope and skeleton React stories in `dist/` provide a cover story that does not match the shipped install-time behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
